gamePage.title: Specula Elementae
gamePage.privacyBody: The camera is only used in the browser to recognize cards. No video is sent to servers.
gamePage.debugNote: Simulate QR codes without physical cards or a webcam. The panel only appears when debug is enabled in the environment.
gamePage.familyVoiceBody: To record or play a family voice, first sign in to the dedicated studio.
gamePage.familyVoiceLink: Sign in to use the voice

familyVoicePage.title: Specula Elementae - Family Voice Studio
familyVoicePage.heading: Family Voice Studio
familyVoicePage.intro: Record hints and stories with a familiar voice using the canvas teleprompter and a simple recording flow.
familyVoicePage.profileBody: Sign in, choose the prompt type, and record a clear and reassuring clip for the child.
familyVoicePage.loginHint: Sign in or create a profile to save private recordings.
familyVoicePage.teleprompterBody: Read calmly, follow the suggested pacing, and save a voice the child recognizes immediately.
familyVoicePage.studioHint: Choose a prompt from the library to start recording in the studio.

familyVoice.sessionExpired: Session expired. Please sign in again.

familyVoice.idleCanvas: Choose a prompt from the library to begin
familyVoice.recordUnsupported: Audio recording is not supported by this browser.
familyVoice.summaryBody: Prompts are recorded from the central teleprompter. Use the buttons above the canvas to move to the next or previous text.
familyVoice.copyHint: Read in a calm, natural voice. The text highlights following the suggested pacing for this line.

tts.providerBrowserFallback: Piper is unreachable, using browser voices.
tts.providerPiperFallback: Browser voices unavailable, falling back to Piper.

ROSSO.name: Ember
ROSSO.description: Ember warms and brings light, but it must be used carefully.

BLU.name: Droplet
BLU.description: Droplet helps plants grow, but it works best when used calmly.

VERDE.name: Sprout
VERDE.description: Sprout grows strong, but only with plenty of patience.

GIALLO.name: Ray
GIALLO.description: Ray lights the path, but it dazzles anyone who stares too long.

VIOLA.name: Eclipse
VIOLA.description: Eclipse makes you pause and observe, but staying too long in the shadows can make you lose your way.

NERO.name: Bolt
NERO.description: Bolt arrives fast and strong, but using it without thinking can lead to losing control.

game.gameOver: The adventure ends here, but you can try again.

printPage.title: Specula Elementae - Printable cards
printPage.heading: Printable cards
printPage.intro: Each card includes its own QR code. Use them with {app}.
printPage.tip: Tip: print on thick paper or laminate the cards.
printPage.playModeFreeBody: all 6 cards are always available, so the game is more immediate and better suited to younger children.
printPage.playModeDeckBody: prepare a deck with multiple copies of the 6 cards, draw 5 cards at the beginning, then keep drawing during the match. This makes the game more challenging and strategic.
